glossary.explanation: The Party's overarching national goal, usually dated to Xi Jinping's 2012 formulation of the Chinese Dream. It refers to restoring China's national strength and international standing.
A national honorary title awarded to outstanding educators. In 2024 it went to Zhang Jinfan and Huang Danian.

t: Upholding fundamental principles and innovating to promote the content-based development of ideological and political theory courses
zh: 守正创新推动思政课建设内涵式发展
paras: This commentary, published in Guangming Daily in December 2024, asks how ideological and political theory courses (sizheng ke) in Chinese universities can develop in depth while keeping to fundamental principles and innovating. Wang Haiwei, Dean of the School of Marxism at Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, takes Xi Jinping's formula as the framework: course construction must advance in step with the Party's innovative theory, draw its content from the achievements of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and rest on three cultural sources. Wang argues that these three elements must be combined through a dialectical unity of upholding fundamental principles and innovating.

The article has three main sections, each tied to one element of Xi's formula: theoretical armament, content support and the cultural foundation of strength. It closes with a short passage describing the work as a systematic undertaking that links history and reality, theory and practice, and the domestic and the international. Wang's aim is that the courses explain 'the logic of China', 'the path of China' and 'the governance of China' in depth and with vividness.

In the first section, Wang calls for teaching the development, the scientific system and the worldview and methodology of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Wang argues that a 'big view of history' can show students why the Party succeeds and why Marxism adapted to Chinese conditions works. The second section uses the achievements of socialism with Chinese characteristics to answer three questions: why the Communist Party of China is able, why socialism with Chinese characteristics is good, and why Marxism adapted to the Chinese context and the needs of our times works. In this section Wang presents Chinese modernization as a surpassing of Western modernization and as an innovation in modernization theory. The third section holds that excellent traditional Chinese culture, revolutionary culture and advanced socialist culture give the courses cultural depth, a 'red' lineage and vitality. It suggests digital teaching models that combine classroom teaching with visits to revolutionary sites, and it calls for ideological and political courses and course-embedded ideological education to move in the same direction.

Wang concludes that the courses should educate a new generation that the Party can trust, that is patriotic and dedicated, and that will take up the task of national rejuvenation. The article also urges teachers to help students analyse international developments and online controversies, and to rebut what it describes as Western theoretical attempts to dissolve socialist ideology. Read the original if you want a concise example of how official guidance on ideological and political courses is presented to the university teachers who deliver them.
quoteEn: Promoting upholding fundamental principles and innovation in ideological and political courses is a systematic undertaking. It requires explaining well the Party's innovative theoretical achievements, grasping the courses' 'content support' and consolidating their 'foundation of strength', while bringing together history and reality, theory and practice, and the domestic and the international.
quoteZh: 推动思政课守正创新是一项系统工程，需要在融通历史与现实、理论与实践、国内与国际中，阐释好党的创新理论成果，把握好思政课“内容支撑”，夯实好思政课“力量根基”

glossary.explanation: Compulsory courses in Chinese schools and universities that teach Marxism, Party history and official ideology. They are presented as the core means of the fundamental task of fostering virtue and cultivating talent.

glossary.zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想
glossary.pinyin: Xí Jìnpíng xīn shídài Zhōngguó tèsè shèhuì zhǔyì sīxiǎng
glossary.en: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era
glossary.explanation: The Party's guiding ideology, written into the Party and state constitutions in 2017 and 2018. It is treated as the latest stage of adapting Marxism to China.
The official term for China's path to modernization, set out at the 20th Party Congress (2022). It is presented as distinct from Western modernization.

t: Always ensure that cultural development focuses on people and ends with people
zh: 始终坚持文化建设着眼于人、落脚于人
paras: This Guangming Daily commentary, published in December 2024, explains a directive from Xi Jinping that cultural development should always focus on people and end with people. Zhang Jun presents the directive as a concrete form of putting the people first in cultural work. In Zhang's reading, it gives guidance for developing socialist culture with Chinese characteristics, strengthening the people's spiritual strength and building the cultural foundation for national rejuvenation.

The piece has four parts. It first sets out the value orientation of the directive through a Marxist view of culture, then discusses respecting and relying on the people's practice. It next turns to the educational function of culture and ends with institutional mechanisms in four areas: cultural production, governance, communication and talent.

Zhang's core move is to argue that culture is both created by people and shapes people, so that cultural development is a unified process of humans transforming culture and culture transforming humans. From the Marxist view that the masses make history, Zhang concludes that the people decide cultural development. This requires three commitments: subjectivity (the people as creators, judges and beneficiaries of culture), historicity (inheriting and innovating the Chinese cultural tradition, with Marxism activating its best elements) and openness (learning from other civilisations). Culture's role in educating people, Zhang adds, means strengthening ideals and convictions and nurturing a new generation of all-round socialist builders.

Zhang calls for mechanisms that put social benefits first in cultural production, modernise national cultural governance, build a multi-channel external communication system and train a large, high-level body of cultural talent. The stated aims are to raise the people's sense of cultural gain and happiness and to strengthen national cultural soft power. Read the original if you want a concise example of how official commentary links Marxist theory to current cultural policy.
quoteEn: The practical subject of cultural development is people, its mode of practice depends on people, and its purpose points to people; without people, there is no cultural development to speak of.
quoteZh: 文化建设的实践主体是人，实践方式取决于人，实践目的指向于人，离开了人，文化建设便无从谈起。

glossary.zh: 中国特色社会主义文化
glossary.explanation: The official term for the culture the Party promotes as part of socialism with Chinese characteristics, combining Marxism, Chinese traditional culture and revolutionary culture.

glossary.literal: great revival of the Chinese nation
glossary.explanation: A central Party goal of restoring China to national strength and prosperity, closely associated with Xi Jinping since 2012.
Official term for a country's cultural appeal and influence, which Party documents seek to enhance, including through external communication.

t: Focusing on the "six attributes" to advance high-quality development of education
zh: 聚焦“六大特质”推进教育事业高质量发展
paras: This commentary, published in Guangming Daily in December 2024, takes up Xi Jinping's statement at the National Education Conference that a leading country in education with Chinese characteristics should have six strengths: ideological and political guidance, talent competitiveness, scientific and technological support, capacity to safeguard people's wellbeing, social coordination and international influence. Liu Yanbing, who heads Chongqing's Party education committee and municipal education commission, argues that focusing on these six attributes will speed the high-quality development of education and support national rejuvenation through Chinese modernization.

The article is organised as six short sections, one for each attribute. Each opens with a quotation from Xi and then lists practical measures, mostly for schools, universities and local education authorities.

On ideological and political guidance, Liu calls for the course on Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to be taught well, for integrated Party-ideology courses across school stages, and for digital tools in this work. For talent and technology, the author proposes adjusting subject offerings to new industries, training top talent in basic disciplines, reforming vocational education and promoting the conversion of research results into new quality productive forces. On people's wellbeing, Liu stresses fairer access, rural schools, group-based school models and the "double reduction" policy. Social coordination is to rest on government, schools, families and enterprises sharing responsibility, while international influence is to come through opening-up, a "Study in China" brand and vocational cooperation with Belt and Road Initiative countries.

Liu concludes that pursuing these six attributes together will give strong support to building China into an education powerhouse. Read the original if you want a concise example of how a local education official translates Xi's national education strategy into concrete policy measures.
quoteEn: To firmly grasp the people-oriented nature of education, we must focus on the new demands and expectations that the people's growing need for a better life places on education reform and development, and deepen comprehensive education reform around the urgent, difficult and pressing problems of the masses.
quoteZh: 牢牢把握教育的人民属性，就要紧紧围绕人民日益增长的美好生活需要对教育改革发展的新要求、新期待，围绕解决人民群众急难愁盼问题深化教育综合改革

glossary.explanation: Official slogan for China's development path, promoted since the 20th Party Congress (2022), presented as distinct from Western models of modernization.

glossary.zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想
glossary.pinyin: Xí Jìnpíng xīn shídài Zhōngguó tèsè shèhuì zhǔyì sīxiǎng
glossary.en: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era
glossary.explanation: The Party's official guiding ideology, written into the Party and state constitutions in 2017–2018.
A concept introduced by Xi Jinping in 2023 for growth driven by technological innovation and advanced industries.
China's international infrastructure and cooperation programme launched in 2013.
A 2021 policy to reduce students' homework burden and off-campus tutoring in compulsory education.

t: Grasping the inner logic of building a shared spiritual home for the Chinese nation
zh: 深刻把握构筑中华民族共有精神家园的内在逻辑
paras: Writing in Guangming Daily in December 2024, Li Junjie asks how a shared spiritual home for the Chinese nation can be built, and answers by setting out seven interlocking principles that he calls its inner logic. Li presents the task as both a demand of the new era for forging a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation and a deeper aim of building a strong country and achieving national rejuvenation. The piece is a short commentary on Xi Jinping's recent statements on ethnic work.

The article opens with Xi Jinping's remarks at the 2024 national conference commending ethnic unity and progress. Li treats these remarks as part of Xi Jinping's important thinking on strengthening and improving ethnic work. Seven sections follow, each starting with "persisting in" a principle and each tied to a quotation from Xi: Party leadership, cultural identity, the forging of a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation, people's wellbeing, a correct view of Chinese national history, core socialist values, and broad interaction among ethnic groups.

Li argues that the Party's overall leadership is the fundamental political guarantee, and that cultural identity is the root, because Chinese culture is the synthesis of all ethnic cultures. Forging a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation is called the main thread of ethnic work and of all work in ethnic minority areas. On the material side, Li holds that common modernization needs shared development, and that improving livelihoods and winning hearts should be the starting and end points of development in those areas. The remaining principles concern a correct view of history, with a call to refute mistaken historical views and promote the textbook and history projects on the Chinese nation. They also concern core socialist values, with stronger national common language education, and ethnic interaction, exchange and integration.

Li concludes that these principles together bind the peoples of China through shared hearts and spirit and give the building of the community of the Chinese nation a strong cultural and spiritual base. Practical proposals include ethnic unity campaigns, work on ethnic affairs in cities, mutually embedded social structures and communities, and exchange programmes for young people and tourism. Read the original if you want a compact, officially aligned account of how Chinese academic and Party-school writers currently frame ethnic work and the shared spiritual home.
quoteEn: Cultural identity is the deepest level of identity; it is the root of ethnic unity and the soul of ethnic harmony.
quoteZh: 文化认同是最深层次的认同，是民族团结之根、民族和睦之魂

glossary.zh: 铸牢中华民族共同体意识
glossary.en: forging a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation
glossary.literal: firmly forging the consciousness of the Chinese nation community
glossary.explanation: A formulation Xi Jinping has promoted since the 18th Party Congress (2012), now described as the main thread of Party ethnic work. It stresses shared national identity over separate ethnic identities.

glossary.zh: 中华民族共有精神家园
glossary.en: shared spiritual home for the Chinese nation
glossary.literal: common spiritual homeland of the Chinese nation
glossary.explanation: A phrase for the common cultural and ideological ground that officials say all ethnic groups in China hold together.
A twelve-word set of values promoted since 2012 at national, social and individual levels, including prosperity, democracy, patriotism and integrity.

glossary.en: correct view of Chinese national history
glossary.literal: view of history of the Chinese nation
glossary.explanation: The official interpretation that all ethnic groups jointly built the unified multi-ethnic Chinese state and its culture. It is used to counter views seen as divisive.

t: Handling the "five major relationships" correctly: systematically reforming the system of fostering talent
zh: 正确处理“五个重大关系” 系统性改革育人体系
paras: Li Jinchang, a university Party secretary, writing in Guangming Daily in December 2024, takes up Xi Jinping's call at the National Education Conference (September 2024) to handle five major relationships when building a leading country in education. Li argues that universities should treat these relationships as a methodology and use them to reform their talent-fostering system in a systematic, integrated way, centred on the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education.

The commentary first sets out the five relationships as the strategic positioning, basic function, value pursuit, development path and key principle of higher education. It then lists four shortcomings that Li sees in current university talent training, and closes with four groups of reform measures.

Li pairs each relationship with a task: supporting national strategy and meeting people's livelihood needs; knowledge learning and all-round development; training talent and meeting social needs; orderly regulation and vitality; and rooting in China while drawing on international experience. The shortcomings Li names are weak ideological and political education, an incomplete admissions–training–employment chain, gaps in building a high-level teaching force, and weak links between disciplines and talent training. The remedies are Party leadership throughout school governance, integration of the whole admissions-to-employment process, comprehensive reform linking disciplines to specialties and teaching, and faster building of the faculty.

Li concludes that universities should apply systems thinking so that their strengths converge on raising the quality of home-grown talent and on producing top-notch innovative talent. Read the original if you want a concise example of how a Chinese university leader turns Xi Jinping's education directives into concrete institutional measures.
quoteEn: Universities need to uphold systems thinking, view problems holistically, grasp the "five major relationships" correctly, and design systematically and comprehensively advance the construction and optimisation of the system of fostering virtue through education.
quoteZh: 高校需要秉持系统观念，以整体眼光看待问题，正确把握“五个重大关系”，系统设计、全面推进立德树人体系的构建与优化

glossary.explanation: A formula in official education policy naming moral character formation as the fundamental task of schooling, stressed since the 18th Party Congress (2012).
Five pairs of relationships that Xi Jinping told the September 2024 National Education Conference must be handled correctly in building a leading country in education.
An official goal of making China a world leader in education, elaborated in a 2024 national plan and at the National Education Conference.

t: Building on the overall "Big Ideological and Political Work" framework to advance supply-side reform of ideological and political education
zh: 立足“大思政”工作整体 推动思政教育供给侧改革
paras: This short commentary in Guangming Daily takes up Xi Jinping's call, made at the second national education conference of the new era, for China to become a leading education power with strong "ideological and political guidance". Lin Wei argues that universities should strengthen the "Big Ideological and Political Course" so that ideological and political education advances while remaining true to its principles and innovating. The author says this requires treating theoretical teaching and practical teaching as one and continuing supply-side reform of such education.

The piece is organised around four paired concepts: the whole and its parts, change and constancy, the small classroom and the large social classroom, and supply and demand. Each section sets out how universities should handle the relationship and offers practical measures. The examples concern teaching staff, curriculum systems, practice bases and digital technology.

Lin first distinguishes the broader \"Big Ideological and Political Work\" framework, which coordinates resources inside and outside the university, from the \"Big Ideological and Political Course\", which focuses on improving the quality of ideological and political courses. The latter, Lin argues, must be planned within the former. Lin stresses that the Big Course is not a new subject: its course character and goal of cultivating socialist builders and successors stay unchanged, so it should be managed within the ideological and political course system. On supply and demand, Lin calls for content that responds to students' generational traits and individual differences, drawing on Party theory, traditional, revolutionary and socialist culture, and on generative AI, virtual reality and digital twins.

Lin concludes that integrating theory with practice, through memorial-hall, laboratory, production-line and museum courses, a \"big teaching corps\" and integrated schemes across primary, secondary and university levels, will widen the pattern of all-round education. Read the original if you want a concise example of how a university Party official frames the practical agenda for ideological and political teaching after the 2024 education conference.
quoteEn: It must be fully recognised that establishing the "Big Ideological and Political Course" is not about creating a new course, but about mobilising social forces and resources through building a big classroom, big platforms and a big teaching corps, so as to promote reform and innovation in ideological and political courses.
quoteZh: 必须充分认识到，开设“大思政课”，不是要创造一门新课，而是通过构建大课堂、大平台、大师资调动社会力量和资源，推动思政课改革创新。

glossary.explanation: A policy concept promoted since 2021 that links classroom ideological and political courses with practice teaching in society, such as visits to historic sites, enterprises and laboratories.
A framework for coordinating all resources, personnel and channels inside and outside a university so that ideological and political education covers every part of student life.

t: Empowering the "Great Ideological and Political Course" through red study tours
zh: 以红色研学赋能“大思政课”建设
paras: This short commentary, published in Guangming Daily, responds to Xi Jinping's September 2024 speech at the national education conference, which called for the "ideological and political leadership" of a strong education nation. Guo argues that red study tours are central to building that capacity and to strengthening the "Great Ideological and Political Course" (da sizheng ke).

The piece has three parts. It first sets out why red study tours are necessary, then identifies the features that define how they serve the Great Ideological and Political Course, and finally proposes practical routes for developing them. Red study tours are defined as organised student visits to revolutionary sites and memorials to learn about the Party's history and the spirit of revolutionary forebears.

Guo contends that study tours enrich teaching forms, make content more vivid and complement the classroom, linking teaching "in the classroom" with teaching "in social life". The author lists four features: value guidance and spiritual influence, immersive learning in historical settings, integration of varied resources, and teacher–student interaction. These are said to help students form correct values and a sense of national pride.

For practice, Guo calls for integrating local red resources into a study-tour curriculum, using role-play and themed speeches, strengthening hands-on activities such as volunteering and social surveys, combining the tours with subjects such as Chinese, history, art and information technology, and setting up multi-dimensional evaluation. Read the original if you want a concise example of how Party-affiliated educators present red tourism resources as a tool of ideological and political education.
quoteEn: The core of red study tours lies in practice and experience.
quoteZh: 红色研学的核心在于实践和体验。

glossary.explanation: A policy concept promoted since 2021 that extends ideological and political education beyond the classroom into society, practice and real-life settings.
Organised educational trips to revolutionary sites, museums and other sites tied to the history of the Communist Party, combining visits with study.

t: Advancing the "big ideological and political course" to strengthen ideological and political guidance in universities
st: A case report on Changshu Institute of Technology
zh: 推进“大思政课”建设 增强高校思政引领力
paras: This short piece, published in Guangming Daily on 13 December 2024, is a case report on how Changshu Institute of Technology, a university in Jiangsu, builds what it calls the "big ideological and political course" (da sizheng ke). Yuan presents the university's work as an effort to carry out the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education, and to make students both professionally competent and committed to family and country.

The article is organised around three areas of work. These are the classroom as the "main channel", the Party-led teaching staff (the "big teaching force"), and the wider "big classroom" of student communities, local red resources, practice teaching and online platforms. Each is illustrated with the university's own measures, programmes and figures.

On the classroom side, Yuan describes the Party committee's study scheme, leaders' participation in collective lesson preparation, and a publicity effort built around a network ideological and political centre. On staffing, the article lists four teams: ideological and political teachers, counsellors, full-time and part-time Party and ideological workers, and mental-health teachers. It reports that such staff make up 1.06 per cent of teachers and students and cites teaching awards and research projects. On the wider "big classroom", it describes a "one-stop" student community with a "1+12+N" Party-building model, red-culture resources tied to the local Shajiabang story, practice bases run with governments and enterprises, and online courses and immersive teaching.

Yuan concludes that the university will keep using "big ideological and political course" building as its main lever. It will further integrate classroom, community and practice teaching, and train more builders and successors of socialism. Read the original if you want a concrete, institution-level example of how Chinese universities describe the organisation of ideological and political education, including its staffing figures and programme names.
quoteEn: The university has written the building of its ideological and political work teams into the overall plan for education and for cadre and talent development, giving priority to them in staffing, funding and resource allocation.
quoteZh: 学校将思政工作队伍建设纳入教育事业和干部人才队伍建设总体规划，在师资建设、资金投入和资源配置上优先保障。

glossary.explanation: A policy concept promoted since 2021 that extends ideological and political education beyond the classroom into society, practice and online spaces. It is often paired with the idea of using society as a "big classroom".
The official fundamental task of Chinese education: shaping students' moral character and political orientation alongside knowledge and skills.
A Chinese university initiative that brings services, Party-building and ideological work into student residential areas, so that these activities reach students where they live.

t: Empowering the building of ideological and political courses through culture
zh: 以文化赋能思政课建设
paras: This short commentary, published in Guangming Daily in December 2024, asks how culture can strengthen university and school ideological and political courses (sizheng courses). Fang argues that Xi Jinping's thought on culture should shape these courses, making them more persuasive and appealing and supporting their high-quality development. The piece opens with a Beijing 'big ideological and political course' staged at Renmin University for first-year students.

The article cites Xi Jinping's May 2024 instruction on these courses, which names Marxism, the achievements of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and traditional, revolutionary and advanced socialist culture as their foundations. It then sets out three pairings of approach: political guidance with knowledge teaching, value guidance with cultural transmission, and innovative teaching methods with practical experience.

In Fang's account, the courses should explain the standpoint, viewpoint and method of Xi Jinping's thought on culture, so that young people can answer the questions of China, the world, the people and the times. They should also draw on Marxist cultural theory and on the fit between Marxism and traditional Chinese culture, extending teaching beyond the classroom. Fang cites a scenic, role-playing class at a memorial site for the 1923 railway workers' movement as an example. Teachers are urged to use generative AI, virtual simulation and holographic imaging to build immersive scenes.

Fang concludes that culture-based teaching will help the courses fulfil the fundamental task of fostering virtue and cultivating talent, and produce a new generation willing to carry the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Read the original if you want a brief example of how official guidance on cultural confidence is translated into proposals for ideological and political teaching.
quoteEn: Ideological and political courses have a distinct cultural character.
quoteZh: 思政课具有鲜明的文化属性。

glossary.explanation: Compulsory courses in Marxism, Party theory and moral-political education taught from primary school through university in China.
A body of Xi Jinping's statements on cultural work, officially presented in 2023 as part of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era.
An official formulation of education's fundamental task: building moral character and political commitment alongside knowledge.
The official name for China's current system and path of development under Communist Party leadership.

glossary.en: the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation
glossary.explanation: The Party's central national goal, referring to restoring China's strength and international standing.

t: Integrating labour education into the whole process of talent cultivation in universities
zh: 将劳动教育贯穿高校人才培养全过程
paras: This short commentary in Guangming Daily asks how universities can carry out labour education across the whole of student training. Taking its cue from Xi Jinping's 2020 and 2024 remarks on cultivating well-rounded builders and successors of socialism, Yang and Yan argue that universities should explore concrete implementation paths. Their thesis is that labour education should run through every stage of higher education, every part of the curriculum and every aspect of student life.

The article is organised into three sections. The first deals with integrating undergraduate and postgraduate stages. The second covers embedding labour education in the full curriculum under ideological and political guidance. The third addresses weaving it into daily campus life.

On staged training, the authors call for separate goals for each level: undergraduates should develop interest and habits, while postgraduates should link labour practice to research and innovation. They propose a joined-up curriculum that combines traditional crafts and farming with new forms of labour such as intelligent manufacturing, together with assessment that mixes process and outcome and quantitative and qualitative criteria. For the curriculum, Yang and Yan want specialist teachers trained to bring labour elements into their courses, and ideological and political courses to draw on traditional, revolutionary and socialist culture and Marxist views of labour. Extracurricular practice should be supported through internships, university–enterprise bases and interdisciplinary projects.

For campus life, the authors recommend including housekeeping and cleaning in behavioural norms, running labour-themed lectures, competitions and volunteer service, and setting up labour weeks or months. They present these measures as a way to build the labour values and abilities of a new generation. Read the original if you want a compact example of how official guidance on labour education is turned into university practice.
quoteEn: Labour education should hone students' labour habits and abilities in many dimensions, with attention to improving their life skills and social adaptability, so as to lay the foundation for their all-round physical and mental development.
quoteZh: 通过劳动教育多维度锤炼学生劳动习惯和劳动能力，应注重提高其生活技能和社会适应能力，为学生身心全面发展奠定基础。

glossary.explanation: Compulsory university courses in Marxism, Party theory and moral education, which the article treats as the main channel for value guidance.

t: Mao Zedong's method of "persuasion and education" and its lessons for today
zh: 毛泽东同志“说服教育”方法及现实启示
paras: This article asks how Mao Zedong's method of "persuasion and education" (shuofu jiaoyu) arose and what it offers ideological and political work today. Fan and Ma argue that the method, systematised in Mao's talk "On the Correct Handling of Contradictions Among the People", rests on a historical-materialist outlook and gives the Party's ideological and political work a distinctive character. They treat that work as the Party's lifeline and a core political strength.

The article has three parts. The first traces the method's formation from the 1927 Sanwan reorganisation and the Gutian Conference resolution, through Mao's 1944 addition on revolutionary political work as the lifeline of the army, to the post-1949 extension of political work to economic and social construction. The second sets out three principles of the method: its human-centred character, its thoroughness and its practical orientation. The third draws out lessons for the present.

The authors build on Mao's distinction between antagonistic contradictions with enemies and non-antagonistic contradictions among the people, which they say are matters of right and wrong. Ideological questions among the people, they report Mao as saying, can be settled only by democratic methods of discussion, criticism and persuasion, not coercion, along the path of "unity–criticism–unity". The authors read persuasion as the "self-education of the people". They hold that administrative orders should be accompanied by persuasion and that everyone needs remoulding, exploiters and labourers alike. They also argue that remoulding comes through long practice as well as books, and that theory must be thorough to persuade thoroughly.

From these principles the authors derive three recommendations for the new era. Ideological work should strengthen its people-centred orientation and its guiding power, using language close to ordinary people and responding to their aspirations for a better life. It should deepen theoretical research so that workers in the field understand Party theory thoroughly and give it scholarly grounding. It should also innovate in practice, through practical teaching, cultural resources and media convergence, using "drip irrigation" and immersive experience. Read the original if you want a concise Chinese-language statement of how Mao's persuasion method is presented in current ideological and political education scholarship.
quoteEn: The aim of "persuasion and education" lies not only in interpreting the world but in consciously changing it, and this is its thoroughness in the dimension of goals.
quoteZh: “说服教育”的目的不仅在于解释世界，更在于自觉地改变世界，这是其在目标维度的彻底性。

t: How theoretical outreach can be "reasoned, engaging and useful"
zh: 理论宣讲如何做到“有理有趣有用”
paras: This short commentary, first published in Study Times (Xuexi Shibao), asks how theoretical outreach (lilun xuanjiang) can reach ordinary people effectively. Wen Lihua calls such outreach a key link in arming the whole Party with theory. The author's thesis is that it must be "reasoned" (youli), "engaging" (youqu) and "useful" (youyong) in order to cover the "last kilometre" and bring the Party's innovative theory into ordinary households.

The piece takes these three requirements in turn, each with three practical points. It frames them within the principles of political orientation as the soul, content as the king and innovation as the key.

On being "reasoned", Wen urges lecturers to master the Marxist stance, viewpoint and method behind a topic, to bring out its links with fine traditional Chinese culture, and to extend it with frontier knowledge and current issues. On being "engaging", Wen stresses clear priorities and genuine questions, real emotion conveyed through small stories about people nearby, and internal coherence through devices such as a single running case or chains of questions. Wen also calls for interaction with audiences through online and offline formats. On being "useful", the author proposes skills-based sessions tied to local production, "order-from-the-menu" sessions in which people choose topics, and tailor-made sessions on urgent public concerns.

Wen concludes that lecturers should answer people's doubts with sound theory and with examples from the practice of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era. The aim, in the author's account, is to strengthen the people's historical initiative and build strength for national rejuvenation. Read the original if you want a concise example of how Party media frame practical guidance for propaganda and education work.
quoteEn: Whatever the masses need, we speak about it, adapting the outreach flexibly to their educational level, receptiveness and real needs, so that they move from passive reception to actively "ordering from the menu", showing the fundamental purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly.
quoteZh: 群众需要什么，我们就讲什么，根据群众文化程度、接受能力和实际需求灵活开展宣讲，使群众从被动接受转变为主动“点单”，彰显全心全意为人民服务的根本宗旨。

glossary.explanation: Organised lectures and talks that explain Party theory and policy to Party members and the public. It is a standard part of the Party's ideological and propaganda work.
Official term for the Party's latest theoretical achievements, centred on Xi Jinping Thought, presented as the continued adaptation of Marxism to Chinese conditions.
The official name for China's path and system since the reform era, combining Party leadership, socialism and a market economy.

glossary.literal: great revival of the Chinese nation
glossary.explanation: The Party's stated overarching goal of restoring China's strength and international standing, often used in the form "the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation".

t: Cultivating a new generation for the era who keep "the nation's top priorities" in mind
zh: 培养心怀“国之大者”的时代新人
paras: This commentary, first published in Study Times, asks how university educators can cultivate young people who keep "the nation's top priorities" (guo zhi da zhe) in mind. Song argues that ideological and political education must make youth believers, dedicated contributors and strivers who tie personal aims to national rejuvenation.

Writing from the standpoint of a university teacher, Song starts from the 20th Party Congress (2022) hopes for youth and from the "great changes unseen in a century". The piece is organised in three parts, each naming a type of person to be cultivated: believers, dedicated contributors and strivers.

On belief, Song calls for guiding students to hold firm faith in Marxism and in socialism with Chinese characteristics. Song urges them to reject "involution" and "lying flat" and to fold the "small self" into the "greater self" of the Chinese Dream, using Party history, practical service and traditional culture. On dedication, teachers are asked to embody the spirit of educators, truly study and believe Party theory, bring it into classrooms and become "great teachers" who unite scholarly and moral instruction. On striving, Song asks teachers to break out of mental habits and comfort zones and to encourage innovation, research and ambitious life goals in students.

Song concludes that educators should carry out the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education and become ideological and political "great teachers". The aim is a new generation who are patriotic, dedicated, able to bear heavy responsibility and trusted by the Party. Read the original if you want a concise example of how Party-school educators frame youth cultivation in ideological and political education.
quoteEn: Only by merging the personal dream of the "small self" into the Chinese Dream of the "greater self", and by using individual striving to drive society's enduring struggle, can one truly hold a broad sense of family and country and attain the realm of the "greater self".
quoteZh: 将“小我”的个人梦融入“大我”的中国梦，用个人的躬耕求索带动社会的永久奋斗，才能真正拥有家国胸襟，成就“大我”的境界。

glossary.explanation: A phrase popularised by Xi Jinping, meaning the matters of fundamental importance to the country, which officials and Party members are urged to keep in mind in their work.
The stated fundamental task of Chinese education, combining moral and ideological formation with the teaching of knowledge.
Slogan introduced by Xi Jinping in 2012 for the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, linking national and individual aspirations.
Popular term for intense, unproductive competition in which growing effort yields diminishing returns.
Popular term for a lifestyle of minimal effort and ambition, a refusal to join the competitive race.

t: Integrating discourse into the course: method innovation in university ideological and political theory courses
zh: 话语融课：高校思政课的方法创新
paras: Dai Yuqi, writing in Study Times, asks how university ideological and political theory courses can become more appealing and effective. The author argues that renewing the discourse system should lead the renewal of teaching methods. Dai names four classroom problems: grand talk, hard talk, stale talk and the teacher's solo monologue.

The commentary asks teachers first to settle "whom to teach, what to teach and how to teach", and to keep to fundamental principles while innovating. It then sets out four paired shifts in how teachers speak: big talk told small, hard talk told softly, old talk told anew, and talk shared by many voices.

On the first pair, Dai holds that teachers must keep a correct political orientation and explain the "big" principles. They should also open themes through everyday cases and local resources, linking the "small classroom of ideological and political education" to the "big classroom of society". On the second, Dai relies on Xi Jinping's call to unite indoctrination with inspiration. Firm language suits stating political positions and criticism, while softer language suits building rapport, and teachers should switch between them. For the third, Dai proposes fresh cases and vocabulary, teaching differentiated by audience, integrated teaching across school stages, and online language. For the fourth, Dai calls for a "big ideological and political course" in which schools, families and society cooperate and in which policymakers, grassroots workers, beneficiaries and students also speak.

Dai concludes that discourse innovation helps the courses keep pace with the times and become more targeted, approachable and effective. The author's stated aim is to unify students' knowledge, emotion, will and action, and to produce new-era people who take up the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Read the original if you want a concise example of how a university Marxism school dean frames pedagogical method in official terms.
quoteEn: Innovation in the discourse system is an important means of keeping university ideological and political theory courses abreast of the times and of strengthening their relevance and effectiveness.
quoteZh: 话语体系的创新是推动高校思政课与时俱进、增强针对性和实效性的重要手段。

glossary.explanation: Compulsory courses in Marxism, Party theory, morality and law taught at Chinese schools and universities as a core channel of ideological education.
A policy concept that extends ideological education beyond the classroom, drawing on society, families and practical experience as teaching resources.

glossary.en: the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation
glossary.explanation: An official goal, closely associated with Xi Jinping, of restoring China's national strength and international standing by the mid-twenty-first century.

t: A four-dimensional path to building a high-quality "Great Ideological and Political Course"
zh: 高质量构建“大思政课”的四维路径
paras: Writing in Study Times, Lu Mingchuan asks how universities can build a high-quality "Great Ideological and Political Course" (da sizheng ke) in the new era. Lu argues that the key is the irreplaceable role of the school of Marxism, which should construct a "great curriculum", a "great teaching force", a "great classroom" and a "great mechanism".

The short commentary opens by noting that since the 18th Party Congress (2012) the Party Central Committee has given ideological and political courses an important place in education. It defines the "Great Course" as one whose essence is the course, whose core is ideology and politics, and whose distinctive feature is scale. It then takes the four dimensions in turn.

On curriculum, Lu calls for a graded sequence of required courses, a wider platform of electives, and coordination between ideological-political courses and "ideological and political elements in all courses", with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as core content. On teachers, Lu proposes strengthening full-time staff while adding visiting professors, part-time teachers, counsellors and student peer mentors. On classrooms, the author wants classroom teaching joined to social practice, with students "going out" and practitioners "invited in".

On mechanisms, Lu urges integrating ideological education across primary, secondary and university levels and drawing in schools, families and society, with the school of Marxism taking the lead. The aim, in the author's words, is a social "grand chorus" of ideological and political education. Read the original if you want a concise example of how Party-school theorists frame the organisational design of university ideological and political education.
quoteEn: The key to building the "great classroom" lies in combining the small ideological-political classroom with the large classroom of society.
quoteZh: 搭建“大课堂”，关键在于把思政小课堂和社会大课堂结合起来

glossary.zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想
glossary.pinyin: Xí Jìnpíng xīn shídài Zhōngguó tèsè shèhuì zhǔyì sīxiǎng
glossary.en: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era
glossary.explanation: The Party's official guiding ideology, written into the Party and state constitutions in 2017–2018. It is the core content of ideological and political courses.
A policy concept promoted since 2021 that extends ideological and political education beyond the classroom to all teachers, courses and social resources.
The university unit responsible for teaching ideological and political theory courses and related research.

t: How to do interactive communication of the Party's innovative theory well
zh: 怎样做好党的创新理论互动式传播
paras: Writing in Study Times, Zhang Liwei asks how the Party's innovative theory can move from reaching audiences' eyes and ears to winning their minds and hearts in the digital media environment. The author argues that one-way, didactic communication is increasingly limited as information flows become decentralised, layered and fragmented. Interactive communication, marked by two-way exchange, instant feedback and social sharing, is presented as the key route to better reach and uptake.

The commentary first argues that interactive communication must be treated as a compulsory course rather than an elective. It then sets out three practical areas: building a team of theory communicators skilled across all media, creating a communication chain in which audiences feel known and involved, and acting on several fronts in cyberspace.

Zhang says news media and platforms already develop comment, bullet-screen and sharing functions, while communication of the Party's theory lags because its necessity is underestimated. The author calls for retraining communicators to shift from a communicator-centred to an audience-centred outlook, while keeping to the political task of arming the whole Party and educating the people. Agenda-setting should address audiences' real concerns through differentiated messaging. Participation should be built in through likes, quizzes, voting and rewards, with opinion leaders, Party school and Marxism school teachers, and online speaking teams. Young people are singled out as the key audience and as agents of secondary dissemination.

Zhang concludes that short video, livestreaming, big data, VR and AR should be used to create hit interactive products. Interaction is described as one dimension of communication, to be combined with lightweight, immersive and targeted communication in an integrated system. Read the original if you want a concise example of how Party-affiliated writers frame the communication of official theory for social media and young audiences.
quoteEn: Doing interactive communication well is by no means an optional elective that one can take or leave, but an extremely important and emerging compulsory course.
quoteZh: 做好互动式传播绝不是可有可无的“选修课”,而是一门极为重要的新兴的“必修课”。

t: Advancing the integration of ideological and political courses across primary, secondary and university levels through reform
zh: 在改革中推进大中小学思政课一体化建设
paras: This commentary, originally published in Study Times, asks how the integrated construction of ideological and political courses (sizheng ke) across primary school, middle school and university can be advanced through further reform. Li Baogeng argues that integration serves the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education and marks the direction of reform in these courses. Despite steady progress, Li holds that challenges remain in teaching content, teaching methods and coordination among teachers.

Li opens with Xi Jinping's 2019 call to treat integration as an important project and with the Third Plenum Decision of the 20th Central Committee (2024), which endorses integrated reform and innovation. The article then takes three problem areas in turn: content, teaching methods and the teaching force.

On content, Li says textbooks for different stages are written by different departments and experts, producing repetition and weak links. The author proposes re-sequencing material to match students' cognitive development, with difficulty rising in a spiral, and drawing on both education experts and frontline teachers. On method, Li notes that lecturing dominates and practice is scarce, and recommends differentiated approaches by stage, from vivid, intuitive teaching in primary school to theoretical lectures at university. Li also proposes practical elements such as VR, museum partnerships and cooperation with communities and enterprises. On teachers, Li describes each stage's teachers working in isolation and calls for cross-stage teaching-research communities, regular joint sessions with peer commentary from adjacent stages, and national and local digital resource banks.

Li concludes that effective integration requires stronger top-level design, better mechanisms for educating students, a stronger teaching force, innovative methods and better allocation of resources. These measures, Li says, will lay a solid foundation for training a new generation capable of shouldering national rejuvenation. Read the original if you want a concise statement of the practical reform measures proposed for integrating ideological and political courses across school stages.
quoteEn: The key to the integrated construction of ideological and political courses across primary, secondary and tertiary education lies in the teaching force.
quoteZh: 大中小学思政课一体化建设的关键在教师队伍。

glossary.explanation: Compulsory courses in Marxist theory, Party doctrine and moral-political education taught at all levels of Chinese schooling and universities.
A stated fundamental task of Chinese education, emphasised under Xi Jinping, which puts moral and political formation at the centre of schooling.

t: Promoting high-quality development of publicity, ideological and cultural work
zh: 推动宣传思想文化工作高质量发展
paras: Writing in the Study Times, Qian Sanxiong, Anhui's provincial publicity chief, sets out how the province intends to carry out publicity, ideological and cultural work. Qian presents Xi Jinping's thought on culture as the fundamental guide for opening a new phase in this field. The article's thesis is that Anhui will pursue high-quality development of this work under Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the spirit of the Third Plenum of the 20th Central Committee (2024), driven by cultural institutional reform and the deep integration of publicity, culture, arts and tourism.

The piece is organised around five commitments, each with three sub-tasks. They cover theoretical study, serving the Party's central tasks, integrated development of culture and tourism, ideological risk prevention, and reform and implementation. Qian draws on concrete Anhui examples: the Liu Chi Alley (Six-Foot Lane) heritage site, the Huizhou and Huangmei opera traditions, archaeological sites such as Wuwangdun, and local industries.

On study, Qian calls for deeper theoretical armament through Party study groups, grassroots lecture programmes and short-video products. Qian links loyalty to the Two Establishes and the Two Upholds and cites cases from Party-discipline education, which in Qian's reading show that officials fail when their ideals and convictions slip. On development, Qian describes culture, cultural industries and tourism as natural new quality productive forces and calls for cultural products, new digital formats, heritage-based industries and "culture plus tourism" consumption scenes. On security, Qian says the ideological front is a frontline: the article calls for tighter ideological responsibility, control of positions and channels of communication, and risk anticipation so that erroneous ideas find no outlet.

In the final section Qian calls for new thinking, concrete mechanisms such as task lists, competitive project funds and a "five-element" accountability system, and a hard-working style of implementation. Qian says these steps should make Anhui a stronger cultural province and promote the Chinese modernization effort locally. Read the original if you want a provincial Party official's practical account of how national cultural and ideological directives are turned into local programmes, tasks and accountability measures.
quoteEn: The publicity, ideological and cultural front stands on the front line of ideological work; it must coordinate development and security and strengthen awareness of discipline, risk and struggle.
quoteZh: 宣传思想文化战线处在意识形态工作的第一线，必须统筹发展和安全，强化纪律意识、风险意识、斗争意识

glossary.explanation: A formula from the 2022 Party resolution affirming Xi Jinping's core position in the Party Central Committee and the Party as a whole, and the guiding role of Xi Jinping Thought.
A Party requirement to uphold General Secretary Xi Jinping's core position and the authority and centralised, unified leadership of the Central Committee.
A concept promoted by Xi Jinping since 2023, referring to advanced productivity driven by technological innovation and emerging industries.
The official term for China's path of modernization under Party leadership, presented as distinct from Western models.

glossary.zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想
glossary.pinyin: Xí Jìnpíng xīn shídài Zhōngguó tèsè shèhuì zhǔyì sīxiǎng
glossary.en: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era
glossary.explanation: The Party's official guiding ideology, written into the Party and state constitutions in 2017 and 2018.
An official economic and policy goal, stressing quality, innovation and efficiency over speed of growth.

t: The spirit of educators: a yardstick for the professional competence of university ideological and political theory course teachers in the new era
zh: 教育家精神：新时代高校思政课教师职业素养的标尺
paras: Following the 2024 National Education Conference, which called for an action to forge the soul and strengthen teachers through the spirit of educators, the authors ask how this spirit can guide the professional competence (zhiye suyang) of teachers of university ideological and political theory courses. They argue that the spirit of educators is the proper standard and driving force for that competence, and that teachers should cultivate their beliefs, morals and character under its guidance.

The article has three parts. The first shows that the content of teachers' professional competence, and the 'six requirements' for such teachers, match the six dimensions of the spirit of educators. The second breaks professional competence into four components: professional belief, method, ethics and ideal. The third proposes a practical path built on 'belief, competence and ability'.

The authors map each of the six dimensions onto a component. 'Having a greater self and devotion to the country' corresponds to professional belief and to the requirement of strong politics. Teaching wisdom and a diligent, innovative attitude correspond to professional method and to the requirement of new thinking. Exemplary conduct and loving devotion to students correspond to professional ethics, self-discipline and upright character. A worldview of 'all under heaven' and 'transforming people through culture' corresponds to the professional ideal of fostering a community with a shared future for mankind. In practice, the authors call for teachers to hold firm to belief by deepening patriotic feeling and international vision, using Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to educate students. They also call for teachers to build broad knowledge and skills guided by the 'eight unifications', and to form a 'teacher–student community' marked by honest language and spiritual resonance.

The authors also urge teachers to raise their development capacity in the digital economy era. This means aligning research and teaching, so that teachers move from 'teaching craftsmen' to 'educator-type teachers', and using information technology, including micro-courses and 'Internet+' classrooms. It also means using personal social media to extend ideological guidance beyond the classroom. The authors conclude that the spirit of educators supplies both the ethical orientation and the working method for teachers' professional growth. Read the original if you want to see how Chinese scholars link the official 'spirit of educators' to the training and conduct of ideological and political theory teachers.
quoteEn: As the ideas and norms of conduct in the field of education, the spirit of educators plays an important guiding role for the professional competence of university ideological and political theory course teachers.
quoteZh: 教育家精神作为教育领域的思想理念和行为规范，对于高校思政课教师职业素养具有重要的指引作用。

glossary.explanation: A set of six virtues for teachers promoted by Chinese leaders in 2023–24: ideals and beliefs, moral sentiment, teaching wisdom, diligent attitude, benevolence, and a broad cultural vision. It is used as a standard for teacher training and ethics.
Compulsory courses in Marxist theory, Party history and political education taught in Chinese universities. They are treated officially as central to moral and political education.

A formula for teachers of ideological and political theory courses, put forward by Xi Jinping in 2019: strong politics, deep feelings, innovative thinking, broad vision, strict self-discipline and upright character.
Xi Jinping's 2019 guidelines for running ideological and political theory courses. They pair elements such as political and academic nature, values and knowledge, and theory and practice.

glossary.en: a community with a shared future for mankind
glossary.explanation: A foreign-policy and ideological concept associated with Xi Jinping. It stresses shared interests and common development among countries.

keywords: community with a shared future for mankind

t: Three dimensions of how young people in the new era can put the Patriotic Education Law into practice
zh: 新时代青年践行爱国主义教育法的三重维度
paras: This short commentary asks how young people should respond to the Patriotic Education Law of the People's Republic of China, adopted by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and in force from 1 January 2024. Xiao argues that young people are both a key audience and a key agent of the law. They should put it into practice along three dimensions: knowing it, studying it and acting on it.

The piece is organised around three headings: respecting and knowing the law, studying and understanding it, and observing and applying it. Xiao places the law within the legal system of socialism with Chinese characteristics and ties it to the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and an international situation the author describes as marked by great changes unseen in a century.

In Xiao's account, patriotism in contemporary China means the unity of loving the country, the Party and socialism, and the law is meant to reinforce this. Young people are urged to study it under Xi Jinping's thought on the rule of law and to link it with the Two Integrations. They are also asked to connect patriotic education with forging a strong sense of community among the Chinese nation, traditional culture, core socialist values, and national defence and security education. The author adds that the law covers a wide range of content and gives particular weight to youth, and that young people should measure their own words and deeds against it.

Xiao concludes that young people should follow the Party, strengthen the Four-sphere Confidence and firmly oppose historical nihilism and populism. They should also stay rational, open and inclusive toward other civilisations. The aim is to become a new generation able to carry the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Read the original if you want a brief example of how official discourse presents youth patriotic education and the new law.
quoteEn: In contemporary China, the essence of patriotism is to uphold the high degree of unity between loving the country, loving the Party and loving socialism.
quoteZh: 在当代中国，爱国主义的本质就是坚持爱国和爱党、爱社会主义高度统一。

glossary.explanation: A formula in Party theory: combining the basic tenets of Marxism with China's concrete realities and with its fine traditional culture.
Confidence in the path, theory, system and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics, a slogan promoted under Xi Jinping.

glossary.en: the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation
glossary.explanation: The official long-term national goal of restoring China's strength and international standing, central to Party discourse since the 18th Party Congress (2012).
The official name for the Party's model of socialism adopted since reform and opening up.
In official usage, a label for views that question or negate the Party's official account of history and its revolutionary legacy.

t: Being good at observing and handling problems politically
st: "Political consciousness" as stressed by General Secretary Xi Jinping
zh: 善于从政治上观察和处理问题
zhSub: 习近平总书记强调的“政治自觉”
paras: This commentary in Study Times explains what Xi Jinping means by "political consciousness" (zhengzhi zijue). Liang defines it as a high degree of self-awareness in thinking about problems and planning measures from the standpoint of the Party's and the country's future and fundamental interests. Liang argues that studying Xi's remarks on the subject helps Party members and cadres strengthen their ideals and convictions, grasp the overall direction and take responsibility.

The article is organised chronologically as a survey of Xi's statements since the 18th Party Congress (2012). It takes six occasions between December 2018 and November 2021: the 40th anniversary of reform and opening up, a 2019 meeting on deepening reform, the 2020 discipline commission plenary, the Party history education campaign of February 2021, the Party's centenary in July 2021, and the Sixth Plenum of the 19th Central Committee (2021).

On each occasion, Liang links political consciousness to a specific task. These include upholding Party leadership, deepening reform comprehensively, carrying out the Two Upholds, arming the whole Party with its innovative theory, pursuing full and rigorous self-governance of the Party, and drawing on the laws of history. Liang presents Party leadership as the defining feature and greatest strength of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Authority and centralised leadership of the Central Committee are described as an historical political advantage of the Party. Liang adds that summing up a century of struggle shows the Party's skill in applying historical laws.

Liang concludes that cadres should treat theoretical study as a political responsibility, keep to the Party's "examination" mindset, and carry the Party's self-reform through to the end. The article is a digest of Xi's formulations, with little independent analysis. Read the original if you want a compact, dated guide to the occasions on which Xi has invoked "political consciousness" and to how Party media present its meaning.
quoteEn: Political consciousness means a high degree of self-awareness in thinking about problems and planning measures from the standpoint of matters bearing on the future and fate and the fundamental interests of the Party and the country.
quoteZh: 所谓政治自觉，是指要从事关党和国家前途命运、根本利益的高度思考问题、谋划举措的高度自觉。

glossary.explanation: A term in Party discourse for conscious, self-directed alignment of one's thinking and actions with the Party's political goals. Xi Jinping often pairs it with 'ideological consciousness' and 'action consciousness'.

The requirement to firmly uphold Xi Jinping's core position on the Party Central Committee and in the Party as a whole, and to uphold the Central Committee's authority and centralised, unified leadership. It was formalised in the Party's documents from 2018 to 2019.

glossary.en: full and rigorous self-governance of the Party
glossary.literal: comprehensively and strictly governing the Party
glossary.explanation: The slogan for Party-building and anti-corruption efforts since 2012, covering ideology, organisation, conduct, discipline and institutions.
A term Xi uses for the Party's continuous internal rectification, presented as the answer to how the Party can avoid decline over time.

t: Strengthening the relevance and effectiveness of propaganda on the Party's innovative theory
zh: 增强党的创新理论宣传的针对性实效性
paras: This short commentary, originally published in Study Times, asks how the Party's innovative theory can be made to "take root in people's minds and hearts". Taking Xi Jinping's instruction on the Marxist theory research and development project as its starting point, Ruan argues that propaganda must apply the principle of linking theory with practice. It should be problem-oriented and aimed at the actual thinking and understanding of its audience.

The article sets out three requirements. The first is to explain clearly how the theory guides each field of Party and state work. The second is to hold to a problem orientation and explain the theory's content while answering practical questions. The third is to grasp the ideological state of cadres and the public so that explanation is better targeted.

Ruan holds that Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era sums up the laws of Party governance and of socialist construction. In the author's view it should not be presented abstractly, but tied to the concrete work requirements of reform, development and stability, of domestic and foreign affairs, and of governing the Party, state and military. Ruan acknowledges that some localities and departments apply the theory incompletely or inaccurately and show formalism and bureaucratism. The author maintains that the theory itself supplies ways to deal with these problems, and that investigation and research are needed to find them. Under socialist market conditions, interests and values are diverse and outside ideas spread online, so Ruan calls for propaganda that identifies the audience's doubts and misunderstandings and answers them directly.

Ruan concludes that explanation of this kind turns study into a process that arms the mind and guides practice. It would also build political, ideological, theoretical and emotional identification with the theory, and strengthen confidence in it. Read the original if you want a brief example of how Party-school and propaganda circles frame the method of popularising Party theory in late 2024.
quoteEn: In the course of opening up, external exchanges are unprecedented, and especially with the rapid growth of the internet, outside ideas, values and online information inevitably exert some influence on the thinking of cadres and the public.
quoteZh: 在对外开放过程中，对外交流交往前所未有，特别是在互联网高速发展的情形下，外部世界的思想观念、价值理念和网上各类信息必然或多或少对广大干部群众的思想认识产生影响。

glossary.zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想
glossary.pinyin: Xí Jìnpíng xīn shídài Zhōngguó tèsè shèhuì zhǔyì sīxiǎng
glossary.en: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era
glossary.explanation: The Party's official guiding ideology, written into the Party and state constitutions in 2017–2018. It is presented as the latest stage in adapting Marxism to China.
Official terms for faults in Party and government work, such as doing things for show or being detached from the public. The Party campaigns against them regularly.
A working method promoted in Party theory in which policy and theory start from identifying and solving real problems.

t: Strengthening consciousness and thoroughness in ideological remoulding
zh: 增强思想改造的自觉性和彻底性
paras: Writing in Study Times, Han Liqiang, a political commissar at the Armed Police Engineering University, takes up the first of six priorities that Xi Jinping set out for political army-building at the Central Military Commission political work conference in June 2024: strengthening consciousness and thoroughness in ideological remoulding. Han argues that the deep-seated problems Xi identified, which Xi traced to ideals and convictions, Party spirit and official integrity, can be solved only by a thorough 'ideological clean-up'.

The short commentary is addressed to Party members and officials. It moves through three requirements: deepening theoretical armament, sharpening right-wrong discrimination through criticism and self-criticism, and testing results by loyalty and unity of knowledge and action. It closes with a call to treat remoulding as lifelong.

Han argues that theory must be studied systematically, through original texts, training and discussion, and linked to practice, so that faith and loyalty are firmly established. Citing Marx on the communist revolution's radical break with traditional ideas, Han points to the Gutian Conference, the Yan'an rectification movement and later Party education campaigns as precedents for correcting deviations. Party members should examine themselves against the Central Committee's requirements, the Party constitution and revolutionary forerunners, and accept outside criticism. Han holds that loyalty is shown in action rather than eloquence: obeying the Central Committee, and behaving the same in public and in private, with or without supervision.

Han concludes that remoulding is hard to sustain and must continue 'to the end of one's life', especially for those in senior positions. Cultivating integrity, ability, courage, vigour and harmony among cadres is said to supply the strength for Chinese modernization and national rejuvenation. Read the original if you want a brief example of how a senior military political officer presents ideological remoulding in the Party's current army-building discourse.
quoteEn: The value of ideological remoulding lies in its lasting a lifetime, and its difficulty lies in sustaining it consistently.
quoteZh: 思想改造贵在一辈子、难在一以贯之。

glossary.explanation: A long-standing Party term for correcting and purifying members' thinking through study and self-criticism. It was prominent in Mao-era campaigns and is reaffirmed here for the present.
The principle that the armed forces must be built on political loyalty to the Party, associated with the 1929 Gutian Conference. It stresses Party leadership over the military.
A Party practice of members openly assessing others' and their own faults, treated as a means of correcting errors and maintaining discipline.
The Party-wide ideological education campaign of the early 1940s in Yan'an, aimed at unifying thought and style of work under Mao Zedong's leadership.
The official term for China's development path, promoted under Xi Jinping since the early 2020s as distinct from Western models.

t: Working on curriculum-system building in universities: upholding fundamental principles and innovating for the intensive development of ideological and political courses
zh: 在高校课程体系建设上下功夫 守正创新推动思政课建设内涵式发展
paras: Responding to Xi Jinping's recent instruction that ideological and political courses should be developed in depth through upholding fundamental principles while innovating, this commentary asks how universities can build a better curriculum system for ideological and political education. Cheng Shiping argues that the answer lies in treating the whole curriculum, not only the dedicated ideological and political theory courses, as the vehicle for this education. The piece was published on the Chinese Social Sciences Net's digital ideological-and-political channel in December 2024.

The article has three parts. It first identifies problems in current university practice, then sets out why a systematic curriculum is necessary, and finally proposes practical paths. Throughout, Cheng divides the system into three types of course: the required ideological and political theory courses, general education courses, and specialist professional courses.

On problems, Cheng contends that some universities equate curriculum-system building with the ideological and political theory courses alone, rely on one-way indoctrination that stresses theory over practice, ignore individual differences among students, and assess mainly through written exams and papers. The three course types also tend to work separately: theory courses stay detached from other disciplines, general education neglects Marxist theory, and specialist courses neglect ideological and political content. Cheng argues that a unified system is needed to meet the demands of a globalised, informatised society, to draw on the educational function of every course, and to put into practice a comprehensive, whole-process approach to nurturing people. The proposed paths are to integrate the three course types and update content with current events and student concerns; to link a first classroom (theory teaching), second classroom (lectures and social practice) and third classroom (field study in museums and research bases); and to combine online platforms and data analysis with offline teaching.

Cheng concludes that building such a system should follow changing circumstances, move towards teaching that is modern, of its time and varied, and rest on systematic thinking that organically fuses the three course types. The aim, in the author's account, is to cultivate talent of high moral character. Read the original if you want a concise example of how a university lecturer in China frames curriculum reform for ideological and political education in response to Xi Jinping's directive.
quoteEn: Universities should actively promote the development of ideological and political courses, general education courses and professional courses moving in the same direction together, and support innovation in teaching models.
quoteZh: 学校要积极推动思政课程与通识课程、专业课程之间的同向同行发展，助力教学模式的创新。

glossary.explanation: Required courses in Chinese schools and universities that teach Marxism, Party theory and moral and political education, such as the Introduction to the Basic Principles of Marxism.

t: Seeking multidisciplinary theoretical support for the ideological and political education of university students
st: Interview with Jiang Feng on using Dabie Mountains red oral culture resources
zh: 【社科专访】为大学生思想政治教育寻求多学科的学理支撑
source: Chinese Social Sciences Net, posted on marxism.cass.cn 2024-12-24
paras: This is an interview by Ming Haiying of Chinese Social Sciences Net with Jiang Feng, professor at the School of Marxism, Hubei Normal University. Jiang is the author of a study on using the red oral culture resources of the Dabie Mountains to strengthen the ideological and political education of university students. The interview presents these resources as a legacy of China's revolutionary war period with both historical and educational value.

The conversation has three parts. It first asks why the research matters, then which research methods it uses, and finally how the study of red culture can be extended through several philosophical perspectives. The oral resources Jiang names include red poems and ballads, explanations given in red-heritage venues, and folk revolutionary stories.

Jiang argues that studying how these resources connect with ideological and political education can deepen students' psychological identification and emotional engagement. Jiang also holds that it can show how Marxism was adapted to the Chinese context in the Dabie Mountains area. The research draws on philosophy, ethics, history, phenomenology and educational technology, and uses five methods: social survey with resource analysis, historical logic combined with socio-economic reality, linguistic and cognitive analysis, interactive cultural study, and multi-directional comparison. Jiang then proposes widening red culture's horizons through four Marxist lenses: existence, epistemology, methodology and value theory. The last of these is tied to the core socialist values.

Jiang concludes that multidisciplinary, cross-field research can give ideological and political education for students firmer theoretical grounding and uncover how the red gene is transmitted and evolves. Read the original if you want a concise account of the methods and philosophical framing behind a regional red-culture research project in Chinese university ideological education.
quoteEn: It requires drawing on the advanced theories, techniques and methods of disciplines such as philosophy, ethics, history, cultural genetics, phenomenology and educational technology, carrying out interdisciplinary research so as to find multidisciplinary theoretical support for the ideological and political education of university students.
quoteZh: 需要借鉴哲学、伦理学、历史学、文化发生学、现象学、教育与技术学等不同学科的先进理论、先进技术和先进方法，开展多学科交叉研究，从而为大学生思想政治教育寻求到多学科的学理支撑。

glossary.explanation: The system of teaching in Chinese schools and universities meant to cultivate students' political outlook, ideals and values in line with Party and state goals.
Culture associated with the Chinese Communist Party's revolutionary history, including its sites, stories, songs and spirit.
The official idea that Marxism is applied and developed in light of Chinese conditions; the interview treats the Dabie Mountains area as one site of this process.
A set of 24 characters in 12 values at national, social and individual levels, promoted officially since the 18th Party Congress (2012).

t: Continuously integrating the Party's innovative theory into ideological and political theory courses
st: Bringing the spirit of the Third Plenum of the 20th Central Committee into university teaching
zh: 将党的创新理论持续融入思政课建设
paras: How should the decisions of the Third Plenum of the 20th Central Committee (2024) be brought into university ideological and political theory courses? Cao and Yan argue that integrating the plenum's spirit into these courses is both a necessity and an opportunity. In their view, it helps young people understand the plenum's new ideas and take them to heart and into practice.

The short commentary is organised in three parts. It first sets out why integration matters, then identifies the content to be taught, following the seven "focuses" of the plenum's formulation. It ends with four practical routes for classroom implementation.

On value, the authors say the plenum report is not only a political text but also an ideological and political education text. They hold that it strengthens students' political identification and faith, and builds their ability to analyse complex social phenomena with theory.
